metaData.title: DeepSeek V4 Chip-Model Synergy: The Flywheel of China's Domestic Computing Ecosystem Accelerates
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Through the cases of DeepSeek V4 chip-model synergy and the Kunpeng Ascend Developer Conference, this article demonstrates that China's domestic computing ecosystem is shifting from 'chips passively adapting to models' to 'chip-model synergy,' entering a new phase of active developer contributions and self-sustaining growth.
metaData.summary: Using the release of DeepSeek V4 as a catalyst, the article points out that China's domestic computing ecosystem is undergoing a fundamental transformation: from a one-way model where chips passively adapt to models, to a new 'chip-model synergy' stage where models, frameworks, and chips evolve collaboratively. The core material comes from the developer roundtable at the Kunpeng Ascend Developer Conference 2026. Through real-world cases from four teams—AIGCode, Tsinghua University, USTC, and a leading joint-stock bank—the article demonstrates substantial progress in the Kunpeng Ascend ecosystem from 'usable' to 'excellent' across three dimensions: adaptation efficiency, performance ceiling, and production-grade trust. Specific data includes: AIGCode achieving 65% MFU for MoE model pre-training on Ascend (nearly double the industry average), USTC achieving an average 40x speedup with its LU solver based on Kunpeng, and a bank integrating AI into its core risk control process, achieving financial-grade metrics such as 500ms first-token latency, 26 billion daily tokens, and 99.999% availability. The article emphasizes that the open-sourcing of CANN is a critical turning point for the ecosystem, where developers have shifted from 'submitting requirements and waiting for adaptation' to 'solving problems themselves and actively contributing code,' leading to self-sustaining growth.

mainPoints.point: China's domestic computing ecosystem is shifting from 'chips passively adapting to models' to a new 'chip-model synergy' stage.
mainPoints.explanation: DeepSeek V4 has, for the first time, validated the feasibility and efficiency of chip-model synergy at a large scale, high intensity, and engineering level—a moat previously deepest in the CUDA + NVIDIA ecosystem.

mainPoints.point: The open-sourcing of CANN is a key turning point, moving the ecosystem from 'vendor babysitting' to 'developer self-contribution.'
mainPoints.explanation: After open-sourcing, developers are no longer limited to submitting tickets and waiting for version updates; they can solve problems, contribute code, and drive iteration themselves. AIGCode's shift from 'queuing for three months' to 'solving it themselves' is a typical example.

mainPoints.point: The Kunpeng Ascend ecosystem has achieved substantial breakthroughs in adaptation efficiency, performance ceiling, and production-grade trust.
mainPoints.explanation: AIGCode achieving 65% MFU for MoE pre-training, USTC achieving a 40x speedup with its LU solver, and a bank's core risk control system reaching financial-grade 99.999% availability prove the ecosystem has moved from 'can run' to 'works well.'

mainPoints.point: The ecosystem is beginning to self-sustain, with developers transforming from users into contributors.
mainPoints.explanation: Non-typical developers like startups, universities, and financial institutions are now actively contributing code and features. The ecosystem flywheel is no longer driven solely by Huawei but has formed a closed loop of 'hardware supporting models, models landing in products, and products feeding back into the ecosystem.'

keyQuotes: China's domestic computing ecosystem is shifting from the one-way street of 'chips passively adapting to models' to a new stage of 'chip-model synergy.'
Chips determine the upper limit of computing power, but the ecosystem determines whether that computing power can be truly unleashed.
After open-sourcing, we can fix small issues ourselves anytime, and discuss larger problems with the community. We have more control over the entire solution, rather than using a black box.
One card can do the work of two.

relatedArticles.title: Google's New Paper Crashes Memory Stocks! 6x KV Cache Compression, Netizens: Silicon Valley Becomes Reality
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Google Research releases the TurboQuant algorithm, achieving at least 6x lossless compression of the KV cache via techniques like polar quantization, significantly reducing memory requirements for LLM inference and boosting speed.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek Spares No Effort to Preserve It! Key Features of V4 Revealed
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article delves into the batch invariance design in the DeepSeek V4 technical report, which ensures engineering determinism, analyzing its core value, implementation costs, and engineering trade-offs.

relatedArticles.title: Tair and SGLang Jointly Build a Hierarchical Cache Architecture for DeepSeek V4
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the hierarchical cache architecture built by the Alibaba Cloud Tair KVCache team and the SGLang community for DeepSeek V4. Through three core components—Shadow Radix, HiCache, and HiSparse—it addresses the logical description of KV Cache in long-context inference, prefix reuse during the Prefill phase, and GPU memory bottlenecks during the Decode phase, respectively.

relatedArticles.title: Deep Dive into DeepSeek V4: Three Paradigm-Shifting Innovations Beyond the Benchmarks
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth interpretation of the DeepSeek V4 technical report, focusing on three paradigm-shifting innovations: CSA/HCA compressed attention, the OPD+GRM post-training paradigm, and the mHC residual stream constraint. It also analyzes engineering optimizations like the Muon optimizer, MegaMoE, and FP4 quantization, arguing that DeepSeek is systematically addressing core bottlenecks for next-generation intelligence: long context, deep reasoning, and computational efficiency.

relatedArticles.title: GPT-5.4 Released: OpenAI's First Unified Model, Truly Native
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4, creating the first unified Agent model that supports native Computer Use by integrating reasoning, coding, and computer interaction.

relatedArticles.title: Redis Creator Builds a Dedicated Inference Engine for DeepSeek V4
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Redis creator antirez has developed a dedicated local inference engine called ds4.c for DeepSeek V4 Flash, enabling efficient execution of a 284B parameter model on a Mac.

relatedArticles.title: After Reading This, You'll Fully Understand DeepSeek V4
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth interpretation of the DeepSeek V4 technical report, systematically analyzing its three core architectural innovations (mHC, CSA/HCA, Muon) and engineering optimizations, demonstrating how it achieves million-token context and performance approaching the closed-source big three through system-level reconstruction.

relatedArticles.title: The Second Half of Large Model Architecture
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article proposes that large model architecture has entered a second half centered on 'scaling communication,' critiques the traditional 'accumulation' paradigm of residual connections, and introduces innovative solutions for inter-layer 'selective retrieval' through Flash Depth Attention and MoDA.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek V4 Report Is Incredibly Detailed! The Full Story of the 484-Day Upgrade Journey
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DeepSeek officially released the V4 series of models, achieving a KV cache of only 10% of V3.2 under a million-token context through the mHC architecture, hybrid attention mechanism, and Muon optimizer, while being fully open-source and supporting domestic chips.

relatedArticles.title: QuantumBit Exclusive Interview with Lou Tiancheng: AI is a Runaway Horse, and Harness is the Most Critical Skill of This Era
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Pony.ai CTO Lou Tiancheng elaborates on the core philosophy of the PonyWorld World Model 2.0: when AI driving capabilities surpass humans, the value of human data drops to zero, AI must become the 'head coach' leading R&D, and the ability to harness this 'runaway horse' of AI will be the most critical skill of this era.
